definitions: A personal, isolated Salesforce environment provided by Trailhead for learning and practicing Salesforce skills.
A free, disposable Salesforce organization where users can experiment with features and complete challenges without affecting production data.
examples: I spun up a new Trailhead Playground to test the Apex code.
Many modules require you to complete steps in a Trailhead Playground.
My Trailhead Playground expired, so I created another one.
